name: Mukuro
source:
A street musician who works alone at Central High School.

He always hides his mouth with a mask.

He has a vague personality and shows no passion other than music.

"Hmm... I didn't hear you..."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
